sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied naga-city-sports-complex.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site. Extensive perimeter crown belt around oval, west stand-side canopy, north court/pool-side crowns and southeast edge grove; green verges are bounded separately from track, court aprons and tan infield. No distinguishable low hedge or formal bed can be separated from the large contiguous crowns; none inferred. Mapped additional north court remains even where absent from this older image. Canopy outside the sports envelope or in river/farmland is recorded, not added to another territory. Crown-width observations: Large north/west/south clumps about 90-110 px; eastern oval-edge crowns about 60-85 px; pool/court gaps smaller. Direct re-inspection during B1 repair: the eastern/southern green bands are opaque mature canopy, not exposed lawn. Those observed bands retain individual crowns and exclude supplemental ground surfaces; the southeast open field beyond the grounds/farmland remains unchanged. Continuous shared-vertex triangular mapping preserves each traced surface before mapped-obstacle clipping; no nearest-roof cell jumps. Entire roof osm:way/231215350 and all its observed corners are excluded from fitting and checked against the actual final mapping. Within-roof agreement is recorded separately and does not establish cross-roof accuracy. Independent roof errors exceed five metres, so the registration gate remains unmet. One withheld roof does not establish distributed campus-wide survey accuracy; differing older mapped roof dimensions/placements are retained, not edited. The image traces and recognizable canopy groups remain the observations; surface/trunk placement clears complete mapped records. Virtual outer mesh anchors come only from the all-used-control affine and are not independent evidence. Independent excluded check errors: 4.13 m, 6.45 m, 4.60 m, 6.08 m. Visible crown centers are fitted to clear trunks within the observed crown footprint (maximum seven metres); crowns may overhang roofs and roads. Crown widths in the dense belts are estimated from image pixels against their matched local roof scale; existing circular crowns approximate irregular/elliptical image crowns. Complete mapped roofs, pitches, full-width paths/roads, water and farmland remain unchanged. Planted islands take precedence over exposed paving; ground under opaque canopy is not invented. No surveyed boundary, species, construction date or exact inventory inferred; no bitmap ships.
